answer: The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own tundra record, and its own share of the walnut quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The zenith ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 1207 identities would post 2578 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
